# gtk4's canvasText override under --simulate, with no C toolchain: each frame
# hands cairo the font family and the text as the `c.str`s CMarshal converts
# them to, and ReleaseTemps frees each after the call that read it (#110), so
# however many frames the host paints, nothing is left held.

env PATH=

sngl test --simulate gtk4 app.sngl
stdout '^ok   1 tests, 0 failures$'
! stdout 'leak'

sngl test app.sngl
stdout '^PASS$'

-- app.sngl --
import ui "sngl:ui"
import draw "sngl:ui/draw"
import "sngl:test"

component label ui.node {
    var n = 0

    draw.canvas(width=200px, height=40px) {
        draw.canvasText(x=4.0, y=20.0, content="count: {n}", style=draw.Style{fontFamily="serif"})
    }
}

func testDraws(t test.Test, c label) {
    c.n = 1
}

ui.window(title="t") {
    label
}
